catalog.applies_to: Xiaomi's LLM-Core team as the creator of the MiMo model families it trains and announces, published under the XiaomiMiMo account.

notes: Human origin approval only. It records where Xiaomi publishes primary release information; it adds no creator, family, release, product or deployment to the dataset, and it does not make Xiaomi a pilot creator.

github.com and huggingface.co are already-trusted generic hosts; the entries below bound link-following to Xiaomi's own XiaomiMiMo accounts on them, which is where its MiMo release information is published, rather than approving any new host.

source_catalog.trust_notes: The MiMo repository under Xiaomi's own XiaomiMiMo GitHub account; authoritative for the MiMo release names and the dated update lines its README carries. github.com is an already-trusted generic host; this bounds it to the XiaomiMiMo account.
source_catalog.verification: Fetched 2026-08-30 (raw): https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XiaomiMiMo/MiMo/main/README.md returned HTTP 200. Its '## Updates' section carries exactly one dated line, '[2025.05.30] We scaled the SFT dataset ... the performance of MiMo-7B-RL-0530 on AIME24 can be continuously improved', and the text 'we present MiMo-7B, a series of models trained from scratch and born for reasoning tasks'.

deferred_origins.decision: already-trusted generic host, not re-approved here
deferred_origins.reason: Xiaomi's MiMo model cards are published under the XiaomiMiMo Hugging Face account. huggingface.co is already a trusted origin through existing dataset sources, so it is noted rather than re-approved.

ambiguities.topic: MiMo-7B-RL-0530 is a later snapshot than MiMo-7B-RL
ambiguities.note: The README's only dated update line names MiMo-7B-RL-0530, a scaled-SFT snapshot; the base MiMo-7B-RL has no dated line of its own.
ambiguities.guidance: Record the dated snapshot (MiMo-7B-RL-0530) against 2025-05-30, and do not attach that date to the undated MiMo-7B-RL. A date belonging to one snapshot is not evidence about another.

ambiguities.topic: The creator is Xiaomi, its LLM-Core team the internal group
ambiguities.note: MiMo is published under the XiaomiMiMo account by Xiaomi's LLM-Core team.
ambiguities.guidance: Record Xiaomi as the creator; the internal team is an attribute, not a separate creator entity.
